question: Are these the same kind of thing?

answers.same: Yes: accept the card (`drift review --answer ID=same`)
answers.different: No, these are different: pick the files whose flagged members are a different kind; they are exempt by path and the card is accepted (`--answer ID=different --set-apart PATH,...`; an entry point marked needs_confirmation also needs `--confirm-entry PATH#SYMBOL`)
answers.not-a-convention: Not a convention: reject the card (`--answer ID=not-a-convention`)

unanswered: A candidate nobody answers stays a candidate and never reaches agents.
